Legal

Privacy policy & terms of service.

How we handle your information, and the terms for using this website.

Privacy policy

Castro Finish Carpentry (“we,” “us,” “our”) respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, share and protect information when you visit our website, contact us or request an estimate.

1. Information we collect

Information you provide. When you fill out a form, call or email us, you may provide your name, phone number, email, town/ZIP or address, and project details.

Information collected automatically. When you browse the site we may collect your IP address, device and browser type, pages visited, referral source, campaign parameters (such as UTM tags or ad click IDs), and cookies or similar technologies.

2. How we use it

  • Respond to requests and provide estimates
  • Communicate about your project, scheduling and next steps
  • Understand which pages and ads bring people to us, and improve the website
  • Protect against spam, fraud and misuse
  • Comply with legal obligations

3. How we share it

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers that help run our website and communications (hosting, form delivery, email, analytics and advertising measurement), when required by law, or in a business transfer where permitted by law.

4. Cookies, analytics and advertising

We may use Google Analytics, Google Ads and Meta (Facebook) pixels to measure visits and the results of our advertising. These services may set cookies and collect information under their own privacy policies. You can control cookies in your browser settings and opt out of personalized ads in your Google and Meta account settings.

5. Data retention

We keep personal information only as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your request, provide services, keep business records and meet legal, accounting or tax requirements.

6. Your choices

You may ask to access, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or opt out of non-essential communications, by contacting us below.

7. Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your information, but no transmission or storage system is 100% secure.

8. Children

This website is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Terms of service

Services and estimates

Information on this website is general. Form, phone or email requests are requests for contact or estimates and do not create a binding agreement. Scope, timeline and price are confirmed in writing before a project begins.

No professional advice

Website content is not legal, financial or engineering advice. Every project depends on site conditions and local requirements.

Communications

By submitting your contact information, you authorize us to contact you by phone, text or email about your request. Carrier rates may apply. You can opt out of non-essential messages at any time.

Intellectual property

Website text, design, logos and images are owned by or licensed to Castro Finish Carpentry and may not be copied without written permission.

Third-party links

We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of third-party sites such as maps or review platforms.

Disclaimer and liability

The website is provided “as is.” To the extent permitted by law, Castro Finish Carpentry is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from use of the website.

Changes and contact

We may update these policies; the date below reflects the latest version. Questions: ecastrocarpentry@gmail.com · (508) 566-1618.
